column1: # session-cleanup catalog — what scan.sh recognizes. Data, not logic: edit this
# after this one) to teach the scan about another machine's tooling.
#   label    shown in the report's owner column
#   match    extended regex; matched case-insensitively against the full command
#            line (process, anchor) or the branch name (branch)
#              orphan      killable when its process tree is orphaned
#              busy        like orphan, but only "named" while any process
#                          matching <param> runs (a daemon serving a client)
#              age         like orphan, but younger than <param> days is only
#                          "named"; a live one older than that is "named" too
#              idle-under  never a tree root; reported "named" when its parent
#                          matches <param>, it has no children, and it is >1h old
# An anchor is where orphans land: PID 1 always, plus a per-user subreaper.
# First matching process row wins, so specific patterns go above generic ones.
